question: Does recent underlying attacking and defensive performance improve next-match probability forecasts beyond established adaptive team strength?
primary_hypothesis: A small pre-specified block of recent underlying performance measurements contains incremental predictive information beyond the frozen Adaptive Dixon-Coles V1 control.
null_hypothesis: The pre-specified Team State performance block does not improve out-of-sample probability forecasts beyond the frozen adaptive-strength control on a matched fixture population.

temporal_status.constraint: Results remain experimental until the historical publication-time assumption is explicitly audited or replaced by timestamped evidence.

stage_1_control_establishment.interpretation: The adaptive-strength control is frozen for Stage 2. This is an experimental control, not a trusted production model or market-edge claim.

stage_2_control.rule: Freeze model structure and selected configuration before Team State fitting. Do not retune the adaptive control using Stage 2 evaluation results.

stage_2_split.eligibility_rule: A fixture is eligible only when both teams have the complete pre-specified recent_5 primary feature block available before kickoff. Missing xG or another required feature fails closed; no zero imputation and no silent feature dropping.
stage_2_split.reason: The governed PLAYER_MATCH_DERIVED_TEAM_MATCH xG representation is materialised only from 2022-23 onward, so the originally registered pre-2021 development window cannot fit the complete primary feature block honestly.
stage_2_split.evaluation_caveat: The 2024-25 and 2025-26 seasons were previously observed only for evaluating the frozen Adaptive DC control, not for fitting or selecting Team State features. They are valid Stage 2 feature-evaluation seasons but are not philosophically virgin data for the overall modelling programme.
stage_2_split.prospective_confirmation: After Stage 2 is frozen, 2026-27 predictions must provide the stronger prospective confirmation before trusted-model promotion.

evaluation.design: chronological development and evaluation with identical eligible-fixture populations for paired Adaptive DC versus Adaptive DC + Team State comparisons
evaluation.market_evaluation: separate prospective phase using timestamped available prices and explicit margin removal; no historical profitability claim from model scores alone
evaluation.multiple_testing_rule: All tried feature blocks, windows, transforms and thresholds must be retained in the experiment record.

promotion_rule: No challenger becomes a trusted FRL forecasting model because it looks plausible or wins one backtest. Promotion requires repeatable out-of-sample improvement, acceptable calibration, stable coverage and a clear temporal/provenance contract.

revision_history.change: Stage 2 development/evaluation periods were moved into the governed xG source era and the Adaptive Dixon-Coles control was frozen after its robustness closeout.
revision_history.reason: The complete pre-registered feature block contains xG features that do not exist in the governed runtime representation before 2022-23. The correction was made before observing any Team State challenger result.

professional_benchmark_note: Current professional/public systems commonly combine dynamic team strength with richer performance evidence. FRL should compare these ingredients empirically rather than inventing an unvalidated composite form score.
